OBJECT Codeunit 50024 Builtin Name Conflict
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=28.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      WorkDate@1000 : Date;

    PROCEDURE GetValueAsTime@1(Value@1000 : DateTime) Time : Time;
    VAR
      Counter@1001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      Time := DT2TIME(Value);
      WorkDate := WORKDATE;
      Counter := 1;
      MESSAGE('%1 %2', Time, Counter);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckWorkDate@2();
    BEGIN
      IF WorkDate = 0D THEN
        EXIT;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
